items.explanation: Here the structure needs an Adj., but 毒 is a noun. Use 有毒 to mean “poisonous.”
知道 means “know,” but here you are stating what you think will happen. Delete it: 想灵芝会帮他 means “think Lingzhi will help him.”
It would be more natural to say 不会帮他 if you mean that Lingzhi will not help him.
Giving the 灵芝 is completed in the story, so it takes 了completed: 给了.
我们 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
It would be more natural to delete 已经 because 吃了 already shows the completed action.
